added dep N17b-05 (configuration 4's co-tenancy runs through its environment-level admission at M2, as the bead's Considerations state).

requests.what: Phylum KA-372 proposal 'per-design launch overhead omitted → 1 at every size' is arithmetically wrong: dropping c_L gives D·W·τ/(Ω·D·W·τ) = 1/Ω ≈ 0.77 at Ω = 1.3; correct the expected outcome (N17-KA lists it corrected).

ShapeSummary.links/depth for quad-a print 17 and 4, counting the fixed foot attachment as a body; the model compiler folds fixed joints (pseudo-inertia summed into the parent), and the shape class's link capacity bounds folded model-table rows (byte model n_b = 13 for the reference quadruped). Count links and depth after the fold (quad-a: 13 and 3) or add a folded count field that N17a-02 reads.

State that its src/pilot/omega.rs and buckets.rs are promoted into frob-phylum's arith (N17a-04) and bucket (N17a-05) modules at M2 and the pilot binary re-pointed, so one Ω and one planner exist; today it calls itself 'the one implementation at M1' without saying what happens at M2.
